review: items 2: "YTD" (year to date) is translated as "del Año Fiscal" (of the fiscal year), which changes the meaning. YTD means the period so far this year, not the whole fiscal year.; items 7: "YTD" is translated as "del Año Fiscal" (of the fiscal year), which changes the meaning. It should be "lo que va del año" or similar.; items 9: "Balance Sheet" is left in English inside the Spanish sentence. It should be "Balance General".
